title: Synchronize clarity gates for PRD dependencies across Eng/Design/Legal
creator: Amira Collins
description: Goal: Resolve open ambiguities in the PRD for Private deployment onboarding so that Engineering, Design, and Legal have a shared set of acceptance gates. Current problem: PRD contains several implied assumptions (networking defaults, contract language for data residency, and UI copy for consent banners) that block final sign-off. This ticket drives a single aligned checklist, assigns owners for unresolved items, and records the conditional sign-off matrix (what counts as approved vs. needs rework).
acceptance_criteria: Legal provides redlined contract text for the data residency clause and confirms acceptable fallback language for non-covered regions.
Design delivers final consent banner copy + accessible variants (AA) and links to mocks in Figma.
Engineering confirms migration plan for customer-managed KMS with rollback steps; lists required infra changes and a PR to configure them.
A shared sign-off matrix is published in Confluence with explicit pass/fail criteria for each gate and named approvers.
No outstanding cross-team blockers remain; any residual scope changes are captured as follow-up tickets with owners and estimates.
notes: Highlights from initial review: (1) Legal flagged the phrase "data residency guarantee" as a contractual obligation — propose changing to "best-effort region alignment" until infrastructure SLA is confirmed. (2) Design noted two variations for consent UI depending on customer KMS vs Redwood KMS — Engineering to confirm feature flag approach. (3) Eng wants to decouple KMS onboarding work from initial GA by offering a documented opt-in migration path in private. We need an explicit compatibility table.
